subject: Prototype pilot packaging questions and runway options
messages:
From: Ana Torres <ana@praxisai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prototype pilot packaging questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was excited by the latency gains on our reranker. We have a couple of procurement/packaging questions as we evaluate moving from a 6-week prototype to a slightly larger runway:

- Can Redwood do a short extension (2–4 weeks) on the current time-boxed pilot if we hit the milestone? We'd prefer time rather than extra credits.
- If we convert to paid in May, can any unused runway be converted into a first-month credit (or a discount) so we don't lose the value of what we've paid?
- Is there flexibility to mix a time extension with a small SKU/credit bucket for burst testing?

I've attached our usage export for April so you can see the token/throughput profile (praxis_pilot_usage_apr2027.csv). Procurement has asked that any addendum include an FAQ on billing timing and the conversion credit mechanism.

Procurement contact is procurement@praxisai.com and Tim Wu (tim@praxisai.com) will be handling the invoice.

Would appreciate a quick options list we can review internally.

Best,
Ana Torres
Head of ML, Praxis AI
(Attachment: praxis_pilot_usage_apr2027.csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Torres <ana@praxisai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prototype pilot packaging questions

Ana — thanks for the usage file, that helps. Quick answer up front: yes, we can be flexible. Below are two principled options that map to common requests we've handled recently. Please tell me which is closest to what your procurement prefers.

Option A — Time-first extension (recommended for evaluation continuity)
- 4-week extension to the pilot (same capacity profile) — no additional token charge for the extension period.
- If Praxis converts to paid within 30 days after the extended end date, we will apply a conversion credit equivalent to up to 25% of the extended period's list value (applied to the first invoice).

Option B — Hybrid runway + credit bucket
- 2-week time extension + prepaid credit bucket (e.g., $3,000 credit for burst tests).
- If Praxis converts within 30 days, the unused portion of the credit bucket can be refunded as a first-month invoice credit or rolled into a usage buffer for the next month (your preference).

Other notes:
- We can cap the conversion-credit exposure (e.g., max $5k) if procurement needs a limit.
- Legal prefers a short addendum rather than amending the MSA; we can draft a one-page addendum with clear billing language.

I'm looping in Rishi to confirm capacity and whether we can accommodate an extra burst window (we've got a few reserved slots but I want to be sure). I'll also share a quick draft of the addendum.

Would you prefer Option A or B? Happy to jump on a 20-min call if procurement wants to walk through the billing language.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: pilot_offer_v1.pdf)
From: Ana Torres <ana@praxisai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prototype pilot packaging questions

Karthik — thanks, this is helpful. Procurement asked that we keep the extension to a maximum of 4 weeks, and prefer Option A (time-first). Two follow-ups they care about:

1) Mechanism for the conversion credit — procurement needs the exact phrasing for the FAQ: will the credit be reflected as a line-item on the first paid invoice, and what triggers it (signed SOW/paid invoice)?
2) Can Redwood put a numeric cap on the credit (we're thinking $4k–$6k), and confirm whether the credit can only be used against Redwood usage or if it can offset professional services (we would prefer it only offset usage).

Also — Tim (cc'd here) is asking for an official invoice/PO-friendly document so they can route it through their systems.

Appreciate it,
Ana

Cc: Ana Torres <ana@praxisai.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prototype pilot packaging questions — internal guidance

Looping in with suggested guardrails. Karthik — propose we lead with Option A as requested, but make the conversion credit concrete. My recommendation:

- Offer: 4-week complimentary extension if Praxis agrees to a signed order for production within 30 days of the extended end date.
- Conversion credit: apply a one-time invoice credit up to $4,500 against Redwood usage charges only (explicitly exclude professional services).
- Timing & trigger: credit is applied as a single line item on the first paid invoice after a signed SOW/PO is received (SOW signed by authorized signatory).
- Cap operational exposure to $4,500 and include a clause that unused credit expires after 60 days if not used.

Rishi — can infra commit to the 4-week extension for the current capacity profile? If not, propose a specific burst window size and we can include that in the addendum.

Karthik — once Rishi confirms, I'll ask Contracts to draft the one-page addendum and generate a DocuSign. Keep Ana and Tim copied for procurement.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Torres <ana@praxisai.com>, Tim Wu <tim@praxisai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prototype pilot packaging questions and runway options

Ana / Tim — quick update and next steps. Rishi confirmed we can support the 4-week extension with the current capacity profile and two short burst slots (one 2-hour and one 4-hour window) during the extension.

We will proceed as follows if you accept:
- Offer: 4-week extension at no additional charge to preserve momentum.
- Conversion credit: one-time usage credit up to $4,500 applied as a line item on the first paid invoice after a signed SOW/PO. Credit applies to Redwood usage only; professional services excluded. Credit expires 60 days after issuance if unused.
- Trigger: signed SOW/PO (electronic signature accepted).

I've attached the one-page addendum and initiated a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://docusign.com/embedded/1234567890 (Attachment: pilot_addendum_docusign.pdf). Tim — if you need a PO or invoice draft, reply and I'll have finance send a PO-friendly PDF immediately.

If this works, please sign the addendum and we'll activate the extension the next business day. Happy to hop on a call if procurement wants to review the exact billing line language.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: pilot_addendum_docusign.pdf)
